en: The liquids and mixtures all bubble and spasm as you approach. Next to the equipment lies a large pair of tongs that look as though they would be adequate for dropping in samples of ooze.$B$BThere is safety gear present, but it appears to be dusty and well-ignored.$B$BDo you place some of your samples into the beakers?
This was the site of a great battle.  Many great battles.
Get this, $n off of me!
It's a rescue attempt!  Let no one escape!
I lost the Cache of Mau'ari. What can I do?
Forty-two... forty-two... forty-two what?  It could be anything!  Forty-two... hmmm...
Come to think about it, most everyone involved is dead.  I'll understand if you don't want to be involved in any of this, $n.

She demanded that we immediately head back to Hive'Regal! Brann would have none of that sass. He told her that there's no way we would go back into those hives without an army backing us up. It had gotten far too dangerous. The number of those stinking insects seemed to have tripled from when we first ventured into 'em.$B$BThat's when Natalia lost it!

Yes, but you'll find it more rewarding if you have skill in herbalism!  You will be required to nurture and cultivate special seeds -- not to swing an axe blindly or gesticulate wildly at passing shadows.  While the Evergreen Pouch you'll receive allows even the simplest brute to grow something, those who show some aptitude will have more bountiful results.
Brace yourselves!
Amazing! I think I have found it, $n!

It is possible for one, not of dragon kind, to obtain the Adorned Seal of Ascension and pass through the protected barrier. While possession of such an item would surely destroy me, perhaps you could utilize it and lower the barrier.
We can make it better, stronger, faster. We have the technology. We have the magic.
For the Dragonmaw!
The Stonehearth Graveyard lies east of the Stonehearth Outpost in the Field of Strife.$B$BThe Horde currently controls it.
What do you think of Dadanga?
Ha! You can't even begin to imagine the futility of your efforts.
Darrowshire will fall!
%s laughs hysterically.
Excellent! You meet the required parameters and specifications. What can I do for you?
I'd love to teach you! Show my sister she's not the only one who knows a thing or two about engineering...
Only a fool would remain in this battle. Farewell, coward.
O'course I'm talkin to myself. Only way to get decent conversation in this city.

Sul'thraze... the first time I heard the word uttered I was around your age. It meant nothing to me then, as it means nothing to you now. It was not until a warband of trolls coming from Zul'Farrak laid waste to the land that I understood... and feared.$B$BMany will tell you that the Splitblade of Suffering does not exist. That it's a myth; a rumor started to scare children 'straight.' But believe me, $r, it exists.$B$B<Trenton loses focus as he runs his hand across the jagged scar on his face.>
Hail to the king, baby!
It seems you'll need another lesson, mortals!
How much further to go?
Please, leave an old spirit in peace.
Farewell to you, and may Elune be with you always.

What's there to ask? He's a monkey you crazy fool. Anyhow, so yea, the monkey went into a frenzy after seein' ol' Brann flop into the sand face first. Nothin' the night elf could do was stopping Glibb here from poundin' on her noggin.
The boss wants all hands on high alert.  The rusty anchor sinks tonight.
I don't get many visitors.  You're looking for something specific, yes?
I'm getting out of here!
%s engulfs the sentry tower. The tower is ablaze!
You dare disrupt our works here?! The master will not be pleased. Take this time to prepare yourselves... when we return, there will be nothing but death and destruction in our wake!
I have no choice but to obey!
Thank you for the armor scraps, $n!
What you doin' wanderin' around here?  Why them small fries not in da shackles?!
Kick me out, will they!? I'll show those uptight cone heads in Stormwind the true power of Niby! BEHOLD!
It's been so long since I was a novice myself that I don't think I'd be the best teacher for you. Try talking to Tarn or Mak, right over there. One of them should be able to answer your questions.
Skwol!  I hold your scepter!  I command you to enter this world!
What is this? You trying to ruin my reputation? I don't teach novices, $gbuddy:lady;. Try talking to the orc Whuut in the Drag of Orgrimmar. He's a lot closer to your level of skill. And brains.
An Ash'ari Crystal has been toppled! Restore the ziggurat before the Necropolis is vulnerable!
Babba booey....
Look to this ravaged field and know the power that the elements hold, $r.
Now let's look for the herb.
Plucky?  I heard race master Kronkrider up on the the tower knows where he is.
The Earth Mother calls and you answer.  You will find the Hall of Spirits on the Spirit Rise.
